title: Documented risk
one_line_definition: The average HCC risk weight per patient for conditions that have been coded at a clinical encounter, calculated as total documented risk value divided by total patient count, restricted to Documented records only.
numerator_meaning: Total HCC risk value (risk_value) summed only for rows where the documentation flag is 'Documented', representing conditions coded at a clinical encounter.
denominator_meaning: Total patient count (patient_count) summed only for rows where the documentation flag is 'Documented', applying the same Documented-only filter as the numerator.
result_meaning: The average documented HCC risk weight per patient, indicating how much risk has been formally captured through clinical coding for the selected population.
scope_note: Only rows flagged as 'Documented' are included; Undocumented and Suspected conditions are fully excluded from both numerator and denominator.

measure_meanings.Documented risk: Average HCC risk weight per patient for conditions coded at a clinical encounter, restricted to Documented records only.
measure_meanings.Documented risk YoY Card: Displays the year-over-year percentage change in the Documented risk measure compared to the same period last year, shown as an upward or downward arrow with a formatted percentage.
